design: Retrospective source-grounded fixed-reference acceptance, frozen before inspecting native results; not ex-ante.
goal: For original deterministic smoke-ci sample opportunities, establish that configured safe-output requests produce their intended repository effects.
population: Original run attempts whose exact head source and compiled replay establish applicability of this five-sample reference profile. Other eras remain unassessed, not failures.

measurement.assignment: Native effect timestamp in inclusive-start exclusive-end period, never acquisition time.

effects.predicate: A repository-native issue creation receipt/state binds its stable identity to the original sample request, has title '[smoke-ci] safe-outputs samples replay', and preserves the run-specific deterministic body text.
effects.partial: Creation alone does not establish close-older semantics or label transitions.

effects.predicate: A repository-native comment creation receipt/state on the same temporary-ID-resolved issue has body 'smoke-ci samples replay comment for run RUN_ID.' and its own stable identity.
effects.partial: Comment creation does not establish hide-older-comments semantics.

effects.predicate: An independently captured native labeled event or API processing receipt proves ai-generated was applied to the resolved issue by this operation.
effects.partial: A current ai-generated label or initial create-issue label is not proof that the add-labels operation changed state.

effects.predicate: An independently captured native unlabeled event or API processing receipt proves ai-generated was removed from the resolved issue by this operation.
effects.partial: Current absence alone is insufficient; add/remove ordering cannot be inferred from final labels.

effects.predicate: An independently captured native issue-body update receipt/state on the resolved issue preserves the original body and appends 'smoke-ci samples replay confirmed the update-issue handler for run RUN_ID.'.
effects.partial: A valid update request or replay-driver completion is not an update effect.

fullAcceptance: All five effects plus temporary-ID resolution, limits/allowed-label restrictions, close-older-issues key behavior, hide-older-comments behavior and protected processor execution are independently established under the exact run source. Unknown safeguards mean full acceptance is null, not false.
requestValidity: Separate intrinsic diagnostic: original captured requests must equal the source-derived samples after authoritative run-expression substitution. Requests do not establish persisted effects.
contribution: Original protected processing receipts must link run/attempt, exact head, request and stable target effect. Editable markers are discovery only. Missing strong attribution does not erase independently proven native effects.
missingness: Absent receipts, source mismatches, ambiguous clocks, unknown target identity, unobserved histories or partial acquisition never imply zero effects or a complete population.
costs: Not measured without matching original period/version costs; no inferred LLM invocation because samples bypass the agent.
decision: Not rated: no native keep threshold or required number of complete periods is supplied.
excludedProxies: same-run memory writes as cross-run memory restoration
